LESSON: READING FOR COMPREHENSI ON

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: READING Theme 5: Fun and Enjoyment: My Birthday
Topic 2.6: Reading for Comprehensi on

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading for Comprehensi on. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why do you love reading?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify information from texts for comprehension

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify information from texts for comprehension
   In simple words: practise until you can identify information from texts for comprehension. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading for Comprehensi on using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading for Comprehensi on in the examples.
2. Explain Reading for Comprehensi on to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading for Comprehensi on.
4. Show that you can: identify information from texts for comprehension

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading for Comprehensi on using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading for Comprehensi on important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read simple texts on home, rooms and furniture and match to given pictures,
2. Watch video on home, rooms and furniture and read along the household items,
3. Locate given household items in different rooms of the house from given texts and read them aloud in plenary,
4. Read simple poems on home,

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify information from texts for comprehension

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
